headline.zh: Google 旗艦 Gemini 4 Carbon 正式向大眾開放，首度支援 Agent Swarm
headline.en: Google Publicly Releases Flagship Gemini 4 Carbon with Agent Swarm Capabilities

detail.zh: Google 正式向大眾釋出號稱歷來最強的 Gemini 4 Carbon，主打多智慧體協作（Agent Swarm）機制與深層推理能力。目前 API 定價為每百萬輸入 token 2 美元、輸出 10 美元，但預計 12 月 1 日起調漲一倍，對需要高階推理的開發者而言是搶先測試的關鍵窗口。
detail.en: Google has opened public access to Gemini 4 Carbon, featuring multi-agent 'swarm' workflows and high-level reasoning. Launch API pricing is $2/M input and $10/M output tokens before a scheduled doubling on December 1st, giving developers an early window to benchmark workloads.

headline.zh: DeepMind 推出 AlphaProof Code：以 Lean 撰寫三百萬行形式化證明驗證 Signal 加密核心
headline.en: DeepMind Unveils AlphaProof Code: Verifying Signal Core with 3M Lines of Lean Proofs

detail.zh: DeepMind 發表專注於深層軟體驗證的 AlphaProof Code，透過自動生成超過 300 萬行 Lean 形式化驗證程式碼，成功驗證 Signal 核心加密演算法。這項突破將形式化驗證（Formal Verification）從學術玩具推向具高度安全需求的生產環境應用。
detail.en: DeepMind introduced AlphaProof Code, an agent system that generated over three million lines of Lean mathematical proofs to formally verify Signal's core encryption. This marks a major step forward in applying formal verification to mission-critical production software.

headline.zh: Anthropic 目標以 1.4 兆美元估值啟動 IPO，七位創辦人預計各套現 2.5 億美元
headline.en: Anthropic Sets $1.4 Trillion Valuation Target for Historic IPO

detail.zh: Anthropic 公布其 IPO 招股價區間為每股 70 至 78 美元，完全稀釋後估值高達 1.404 兆美元，將成史上規模最大的公開上市案之一。七位共同創辦人各預計出售等額股份套現約 2.5 億美元，同時維持對公司的控制權。
detail.en: Anthropic set an IPO price range between $70 and $78 per share, reaching an implied valuation of up to $1.404 trillion. Each of the seven co-founders plans to cash out roughly $250 million while retaining voting control over the enterprise.

headline.zh: Chrome 團隊開源 modern-web-guidance，修正 Coding Agent 慣用老舊語法問題
headline.en: Google Chrome Team Opens Modern Web Guidance for Coding Agents

detail.zh: 許多程式碼生成 Agent 由於訓練資料權重偏向歷史存檔，仍習慣生成約 2019 年代的老舊 JavaScript 語法。Chrome 團隊開源此 guidance 專案，提供標準 Prompt 與情境規範，引導 Agent 善用現代 Web 原生 API 與全新標準。
detail.en: Google Chrome engineers open-sourced modern-web-guidance to stop coding agents from writing obsolete ~2019-era JavaScript. It provides standardized prompt guidelines to enforce modern web primitives and latest browser APIs.

headline.zh: Simon Willison 釋出 llm-gemini 0.36 與 llm-anthropic 0.31 CLI 插件支援
headline.en: Simon Willison Updates llm CLI Plugins for Gemini 4 Carbon and Fable 5.2

detail.zh: 知名開源 LLM 命令列工具快速跟進，llm-gemini 0.36 第一時間支援剛公開的 Gemini 4 Carbon（支援高/中/低 thinking 階層）；llm-anthropic 0.31 則整合了 Anthropic 最新的 Fable 5.2 與 Mythos 5.2 模型。
detail.en: Simon Willison updated his open-source llm CLI tools: llm-gemini 0.36 brings immediate access to Gemini 4 Carbon across thinking levels, while llm-anthropic 0.31 adds support for Anthropic's new Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2.

headline.zh: 社群反思 AI 生成程式碼帶來的架構脆弱性與維護性債務
headline.en: Developer Community Warns of Fragile Codebases Driven by AI Generation

detail.zh: Hacker News 與 Reddit 熱議「強制 100% 使用 AI 寫 Code 一年後，無人能理解系統架構」的案例。討論指出，AI 工具雖加速單元產出，但容易在 prompt 未明示 ownership 時不斷堆疊重複架構，造成缺乏整體設計的技術債黑洞。
detail.en: Developer threads highlight the mounting fragility of AI-heavy codebases, noting cases where 'nobody understands the code a year after a 100% AI mandate.' Discussions emphasize that without clear code ownership prompts, models duplicate logic and inflate structural debt.

headline.zh: Anthropic 推出辦公套件：Claude Sheets、Whiteboards、Data 與 Meetings
headline.en: Anthropic Expands into AI Office Suite with Sheets, Whiteboards, and Meetings

detail.zh: Anthropic 正式從開發與 API 市場進軍生產力辦公軟體，推出包含試算表、電子白板與數據分析模組，並透過 Claude Meetings 能在對話當下即時生成任務排程與連結外部工作軟體，正面挑戰微軟與 Google 的生產力生態。
detail.en: Anthropic is rolling out an AI-native workplace suite including Claude Sheets, Whiteboards, Claude Data, and Claude Meetings. The tools turn live discussions into structured timelines and diagrams while querying internal enterprise applications.

headline.zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Business，支援品牌驗證 Agent 與商業資訊管理
headline.en: OpenAI Introduces Verified Business Profiles and Agents in ChatGPT

detail.zh: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT 商業資訊中心與驗證版「Business Agents」，首波開放給美國合格電商與線上服務。使用者可直接在對話中比較商品並轉化為購買行為，使 ChatGPT 更進一步演變為商務搜尋與交易入口。
detail.en: OpenAI announced Businesses in ChatGPT, enabling brands to maintain verified profiles and deploy interactive Business Agents for product comparison and discovery, turning ChatGPT into a transactional search competitor.

headline.zh: Adobe MAX 大會全面押注 Agentic AI：開放第三方 Agent 介入創作流程
headline.en: Adobe Goes All-In on Agentic AI and MCP Integration at Adobe MAX

detail.zh: Adobe 於 MAX 大會宣布將旗下 Creative Cloud 全面整合 AI Agent，除了強化 Photoshop 與 Premiere 的智慧物件移除功能外，更藉由支援 MCP（Model Context Protocol）架構，允許外部第三方 Agent 直接讀取並修改創意專案檔。
detail.en: At Adobe MAX, Adobe unveiled deep agentic integrations across Creative Cloud and Firefly, adopting standard agent protocols like MCP to let third-party assistants directly manipulate project timelines and design files.

headline.zh: Meta 發表極輕量邊緣推論模型 Muse Ember，主打 Agent 高頻子任務
headline.en: Meta Launches Muse Ember: Ultra-Efficient Model for Frequent Agent Tasks

detail.zh: Meta AI 推出對標 Claude Haiku 與 GPT-6 Luna 的極致輕量化模型 Muse Ember，專為工具呼叫（Tool calls）、代碼子任務、智慧路由與長文本抽取設計。每百萬 input token 僅需 $0.10、output $0.50，主打低成本的 Agent 背景工作輪詢。
detail.en: Meta unveiled Muse Ember, a compact model optimized for high-frequency agent routines like tool calling, routing, and parsing. Priced at $0.10/M input and $0.50/M output tokens, it targets background agent operations at competitive pricing.

headline.zh: DeepMind 發表 Gemini Robotics 2.5 及 ASIMOV-jailbreak 開源安全基準
headline.en: DeepMind Releases Gemini Robotics 2.5 and ASIMOV-jailbreak Safety Benchmark

detail.zh: DeepMind 揭露其具身智慧（Embodied AI）新架構 Gemini Robotics 2.5，實體操控任務成功率提升達一倍。同步釋出開源基準 ASIMOV-jailbreak，評估具身多模態模型抵抗惡意實體操作指令的防禦能力。
detail.en: DeepMind unveiled Gemini Robotics 2.5, doubling success rates across several manipulation tasks, alongside 'ASIMOV-jailbreak', an open benchmark designed to evaluate physical security and adversarial safety in robotics foundation models.

headline.zh: Hugging Face 推出決策模型（Decision Models）專區，推進強化學習落地
headline.en: Hugging Face Hub Introduces Native Support for Decision Models

detail.zh: Hugging Face 宣布於 Hub 原生支援 Decision Models，擴展除傳統 LLM 文本輸出外的強化學習與序貫決策模型託管。這為自駕系統、機器人控制與量化交易開發者提供標準化的開源權重分享規範。
detail.en: Hugging Face Hub launched support for Decision Models, expanding its ecosystem beyond traditional generative text to reinforcement learning and sequential decision agents for robotics and operational planning.

headline.zh: 紐約州 AI 安全法正式生效，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 等實驗室納入強制監管
headline.en: New York AI Safety Law Enters into Force for Frontier Developers

detail.zh: 紐約州全面的 AI 安全法規正式上路，要求 OpenAI、Anthropic 等前沿模型開發商完成強制註冊、定期公開安全性評估報告，並在發生重大關鍵資安或安全事件時限期通報，違者將面臨鉅額罰鍰。
detail.en: New York has begun enforcing its comprehensive AI safety legislation, mandating that frontier AI labs register, disclose safety practices, and report critical failure incidents under the threat of regulatory penalties.

headline.zh: Fireworks AI 資安外洩事件波及 Notion，第三方 AI 供應鏈風險升溫
headline.en: Fireworks AI Breach Impacts Notion and Highlights AI Supply Chain Risks

detail.zh: 雲端推論平台 Fireworks AI 發生安全事件，導致客戶 Notion 及其部分企業使用者的資料暴露。此事件凸顯現代軟體過度仰賴第三方模型 API 時，上游供應鏈漏洞所帶來的連鎖資安衝擊。
detail.en: A security breach at inference provider Fireworks AI affected enterprise client Notion, underscoring growing vulnerability and compliance concerns around third-party model inference providers in production stacks.

headline.zh: AI 算力信貸風險浮現：CoreWeave 債券殖利率飆破 16%
headline.en: AI Credit Stress Mounts as CoreWeave Bond Yield Tops 16%

detail.zh: 專注 GPU 雲端運算的獨角獸 CoreWeave 債券殖利率升破 16%，反映二級市場對重度舉債採購硬體的算力服務商抱持違約擔憂。高利率環境下硬體折舊與巨額負債正對 AI 基礎設施供應商施壓。
detail.en: Yields on debt issued by GPU cloud provider CoreWeave spiked past 16%, signaling rising credit market anxiety over the massive debt financing used to build out AI data centers amid rapid hardware depreciation.

headline.zh: 研究員爆料 Grok Build 編程 Agent 存取控制漏洞，洩露包含 SpaceXSI 在內 35,000 個應用資料
headline.en: Researcher reveals Grok Build coding agent exposed 35,000 applications, leaking SpaceXSI data

headline.zh: eBay 全面封鎖以 Meta Muse 為首的第三方 AI Agent 爬取與採購流量
headline.en: eBay moves to block automated shopping agents like Meta Muse from browsing its marketplace

headline.zh: Google 擴展專用硬體產品線，推出支援機密訓練與高記憶體容量的兩款新型 TPU
headline.en: Google introduces two specialized TPUs aimed at confidential training and memory capacity

headline.zh: Hugging Face 開放以 Google Cloud 帳戶統一付費，簡化企業採購與部署管道
headline.en: Hugging Face Hub adds integration to allow billing directly through Google Cloud accounts

headline.zh: 獨立遊戲大獎 IGF 評審抵制生成式 AI，熱門遊戲《Big Walk》承認定稿前曾局部使用
headline.en: IGF jurors protest generative AI in games as Big Walk admits to limited AI usage
